name: Perspective API
tagline: Toxicity and abuse scoring for online comments via ML models
description: Google's Perspective API scores text for toxicity, severe toxicity, insult, threat, identity attack, and related attributes using machine learning models trained for content moderation. Developers send comment text and receive attribute probability scores for filtering, ranking, or flagging user-generated content.

auth.details: Google Cloud API key as query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY; enable the Perspective Comment Analyzer API in Google Cloud Console

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1 QPS free by default; higher free quotas available on request (see docs)
pricing.paid_plans: Contact for higher quotas; primarily free with request-based quota increases

rate_limits: Default 1 query per second (QPS); higher limits available via quota request

example.request: curl -X POST 'https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze?key=YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"comment":{"text":"This is a test comment"},"languages":["en"],"requestedAttributes":{"TOXICITY":{}}}'

use_cases: score comment toxicity for moderation queues
flag identity attacks or threats in user posts
filter toxic chat messages before display
rank forum comments by toxicity score
batch-analyze UGC for community health dashboards
